_comment: GravityG PocketMine-MP Vanilla Preview egg for Pterodactyl
name: GravityG PocketMine-MP Vanilla Preview
author: GravityGDev
description: Test egg for GravityG PocketMine-MP Vanilla Preview builds. Installs the PM5 PHP runtime and the selected prerelease PHAR.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

apt-get update
apt-get install -y curl ca-certificates file tar

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

ARCH="$(uname -m)"
case "$ARCH" in
  x86_64|amd64) ARCH="x86_64" ;;
  aarch64|arm64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
  *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $ARCH"; exit 1 ;;
esac

PHP_URL="https://github.com/pmmp/PHP-Binaries/releases/download/pm5-latest/PHP-8.2-Linux-${ARCH}-PM5.tar.gz"

echo "Downloading PocketMine PM5 PHP runtime..."
curl -fL "$PHP_URL" | tar -xz

EXTENSION_DIR="$(find bin -type d -name '*debug-zts*' | head -n 1)"
if [ -z "$EXTENSION_DIR" ]; then
  echo "Could not find PocketMine PHP extension directory"
  exit 1
fi

if grep -q '^extension_dir' bin/php7/bin/php.ini; then
  sed -i "s#^extension_dir=.*#extension_dir=\"$EXTENSION_DIR\"#" bin/php7/bin/php.ini
else
  printf '\nextension_dir="%s"\n' "$EXTENSION_DIR" >> bin/php7/bin/php.ini
fi

echo "Downloading GravityG Vanilla Preview PHAR..."
curl -fL "$PREVIEW_URL" -o PocketMine-MP.phar
curl -fL "${PREVIEW_URL}.sha256" -o PocketMine-MP.phar.sha256
sha256sum -c PocketMine-MP.phar.sha256

if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then
  curl -fL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs/main/minecraft/bedrock/pocketmine_mp/server.properties" -o server.properties
fi

touch banned-ips.txt banned-players.txt ops.txt white-list.txt server.log
mkdir -p players worlds plugins resource_packs

echo "GravityG PocketMine-MP Vanilla Preview installation complete."
./bin/php7/bin/php -v

variables.name: Vanilla Preview PHAR URL
variables.description: Direct GitHub release URL for the GravityG PocketMine-MP Vanilla Preview PHAR.
